headline: Integration test: dynamic informer syncs and follows changes via router
reason: Adds a new integration subtest only; no production code changes, and it asserts existing router watch behavior.
summary: Adds a subtest that starts a dynamic shared informer through the router, waits for cache sync, creates a Thing, and checks the informer sees the add and then an update. It exercises the new watch path end to end but cannot affect production behavior, so a short skim is enough.
